title: PhiloDeka
description:
Simple rules. Spectacular chain reactions.

Craft Your Unique Build6 Runes + 8 Shaping skills + 140+ Charmstones = Endless strategic possibilities

Each level deals you a hand of number cards. Use Shaping to rewrite card values, trigger Charmstone chains, and compose the perfect "Deka". Build your ideal strategy across 20 levels.

• Six paths: Each Rune offers a distinct playstyle that defines your core scoring strategy. Will you pick the [Tree] Rune for a steady, cumulative approach? Or the [Wind] Rune for bold, time-pressured rewards? Swap one in, and you're thinking in a completely new way.

• Shaping the board: Add, double, split, or randomize — eight Shaping skills, each with its own flair. There's always more than one way to play your hand.

• Everything connects: After each level, visit the shop to browse new Charmstones. They interact with your Rune and Shaping to trigger chain bonuses. Some Charmstones upgrade into two forms — same stone, different possibilities.

• The art of Deka: A rule you grasp in an instant, yet one step away can still sting. It's a craft — and a state of mind.

Realm of ZenMinimalist visuals and original soothing soundtracks — immerse yourself in the world of PhiloDeka.

Full Game Content- 6 Runes

- 8 Shaping skills

- 140+ Charmstones

- 20 Levels

- 18 Challenges, each with 4 tiers

Add PhiloDeka to your wishlist now and begin a zen journey of cards and strategy!
description_short: Where zen meets roguelike. Runes, Shapings, Charmstones, number cards. Simple rules, infinite chains.
